about_the_game:
A set of items that cause a Golden Pom to descend when used.
The mighty Pom grants AT Bonuses and guarantees that all party members will gain one level after battle. It also guarantees that Zeram Powder x1 will be obtained after battle.
Contains the following items:

G-Pom Fruit x3

※After purchase, items can be obtained in-game by selecting ITEM from the main menu, and then selecting newly added content within the DLC tab.

※If the carrying capacity for an item has been reached, additional items will be discarded.

※The main game Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter is necessary to use this content. In the event the latest patch is necessary, please update the game first and then make use of the content.
